headword: {六法全書|ろっぽうぜんしょ}
gloss: compendium of laws; complete book of the Six Codes

definitions.gloss: compendium of laws; complete book of the Six Codes
definitions.explanation: A comprehensive reference volume that collects the texts of the major Japanese statutes, centered on the Six Codes ({六法|ろっぽう}). A standard tool for law students and legal professionals.

examples.japanese: {六法全書|ろっぽうぜんしょ}で{条文|じょうぶん}を{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: to look up a statute in the compendium of laws.

examples.japanese: {法学部|ほうがくぶ}の{学生|がくせい}はみな{六法全書|ろっぽうぜんしょ}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: Law students all own a compendium of laws.

examples.japanese: {分厚|ぶあつ}い{六法全書|ろっぽうぜんしょ}を{最初|さいしょ}から{読|よ}む{人|ひと}はいないが、{辞書|じしょ}のように{引|ひ}いて{使|つか}う。
examples.english: No one reads the thick compendium of laws from the beginning; people look things up in it like a dictionary.

notes:
Composed of {六法|ろっぽう} (the Six Codes) + {全書|ぜんしょ} (complete/comprehensive book). A thick, dictionary-like volume collecting statute texts; also the title of well-known published editions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {六法全書|ろっぽうぜんしょ}を{引|ひ}く: to look something up in the compendium
- {分厚|ぶあつ}い{六法全書|ろっぽうぜんしょ}: a thick compendium of laws

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {六法|ろっぽう}: the Six Codes — the collection of core statutes themselves, as opposed to the printed volume
- {判例集|はんれいしゅう}: a casebook — a companion volume collecting court precedents
